row.question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.
Can Spirits May Yet Dream flip a Fear Card already earned, on top of the deck or deeper in the deck?

Three Fear Cards were earned in a known order. During the Fear step, may players inspect all three before resolving the first? In which order are they resolved, and where does each card go once resolved?
When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?

row.answer: Move the eighth marker to earn the top Fear card face-down, reset all 8 to the pool and put the remaining 2 generated Fear toward the next card. Terror II applies as soon as exposed (subject to outcome check at action-tree end). Keep card hidden until Fear step, resolving in earned order at the then-current Terror level only.
Yes, its first effect can flip any Fear Card in those locations.
Resolve them one at a time in earned order, revealing/reading each only as it is resolved and without looking ahead. After resolution put it in the Fear Discard space.

row.question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.
required_facts: The eighth Fear marker earns the top Fear card face-down, then reset all 8 markers to the Fear Pool.
The remaining 2 generated Fear go toward the next card.
Exposed Terror II takes effect immediately.
Reveal the earned card only as it is resolved during the Invader Phase's Fear step.

key_context_not_required.fact: Outcome check occurs at action-tree end.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks marker handling, Terror timing and Fear-card reveal/resolution, not a victory/defeat check.

key_context_not_required.fact: An initial stack of earned Fear cards is resolved in earned order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The given effect earns one card. The prompt asks its reveal/resolution time and Terror level, not the ordering of an initial multi-card earned stack.

key_context_not_required.fact: Resolve an earned Fear card using only the then-current Terror Level.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The stem asks reveal/resolution time, not which Terror-level text to use.

required_facts: Do not inspect all earned Fear Cards before resolving the first; reveal/read them one at a time without looking ahead.
Resolve the initial earned stack in the order the cards were earned.
After resolving a Fear Card, put it in the Fear Discard space.

row.question: When Spirits May Yet Dream grants its target an Element, may that Spirit choose an Element it currently has none of, or must the chosen Element already be present?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The granted Element must be a type the target already has at least one of; an absent Element cannot be chosen.
required_facts: The granted Element must be a type the target already has at least one of; an absent Element cannot be chosen.
